title: Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge Boss Guide: Phases, Elemental Mechanics and Rewards
summary: Complete endgame boss guide for Doryani covering his three elemental phases, golem adds, thaumaturgical beam mechanics and unique reward table.
description: Learn how to beat Doryani the Royal Thaumaturge in Path of Exile 2 endgame with phase breakdowns, elemental attack tables, community evidence and rewards.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Doryani surrounded by swirling elemental energy with his thaumaturgical sceptre raised

sections.title: Remember These Three Things First
sections.callout: Each phase changes Doryani's element — check the colour of his sceptre glow.
calloutDetail: Phase 1 is fire (red glow), Phase 2 is cold (blue glow), Phase 3 is lightning (purple glow). Your highest resistance should match the current phase.
Flask swapping between phases is the single biggest survival improvement for most builds.

answers.label: Hardest phase
answers.text: Phase 3 lightning — fastest attacks and golem adds

answers.label: Key preparation
answers.text: Three resistance flasks (Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz) for phase swapping

steps.label: Find the Thaumatophorium map
body: The Thaumatophorium is a unique endgame map that drops from Tier 12+ maps. It can also be obtained via divination card 'The Professor'.

steps.label: Run the map to the laboratory
body: The map is a linear corridor of thaumaturgical laboratories. Clear trash packs to reach the final chamber.

steps.label: Enter Doryani's chamber
body: Doryani awaits in a circular arena with three elemental conduits on the walls. The fight begins on approach.

facts.label: Arena layout
facts.note: Conduits glow with the active element

facts.label: Party size
facts.note: HP scales; golem count does not

items.label: Three elemental flasks
checks: Bring Ruby, Sapphire and Topaz flasks.
items.why: Each phase deals a different element; swapping flasks at phase transitions provides 50% reduced elemental damage taken.
items.fix: Use utility flask slots; sacrifice a life flask if needed — Doryani's damage is elemental, not physical.

items.label: All elemental resistances 75%
checks: Verify fire, cold and lightning resistance are all capped.
items.why: You will face all three elements across the fight; any uncapped resistance is exploited in its phase.
items.fix: Use Prismatic Ring, crafted suffixes, or Purity of Elements aura.

items.label: High single-target DPS (500k+)
items.why: Phase 3 has a soft enrage at 60 seconds where golem spawn rate doubles.
items.fix: Bring a focused single-target skill; save AoE for golems only.

items.label: Golem clear speed
checks: Ensure you can kill a golem in under 3 seconds.
items.why: Golems apply an elemental weakness aura that stacks; three or more alive simultaneously is lethal.
items.fix: Use a secondary AoE skill or minion army for golem management.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Fire Conduit
phases.trigger: Fight begins; Doryani's sceptre glows red.
objectives: Learn the flame beam and fire nova timing.
notes: Doryani alternates between a channeled flame beam (3s duration, rotates slowly) and a fire nova (expanding ring, 6m radius).
The flame beam tracks your position but rotates slowly — keep circling. The fire nova telegraphs with a ground ring 1 second before expanding.
One Fire Golem spawns at 80% HP. Kill it quickly to avoid its burning aura.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Cold Conduit
phases.trigger: Doryani reaches 66% HP; sceptre glow shifts to blue.
objectives: Manage Cold Golems (two spawn at 55% and 40% HP).
Avoid the frost field that covers 50% of the arena.
notes: Doryani's attacks shift to cold: frost bolt barrage (5 projectiles, spread pattern) and an expanding frost field from his feet.
The frost field grows to cover half the arena over 10 seconds then recedes. Stay at range during expansion.
Cold Golems apply a chilling aura that slows you by 30%. Two alive simultaneously makes dodging nearly impossible.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Lightning Conduit
phases.trigger: Doryani reaches 33% HP; sceptre glow shifts to purple; all three conduits activate.
objectives: Dodge the thaumaturgical beam (full arena sweep).
notes: Doryani gains 30% increased cast speed. His primary attack is a lightning beam that sweeps the arena in a random direction over 2 seconds.
A Lightning Golem spawns every 15 seconds. At 60 seconds into Phase 3, spawn rate doubles to every 8 seconds (soft enrage).
The thaumaturgical beam is a 4-second channeled sweep covering the full arena. Hide behind a conduit pillar to break line of sight.

attacks.name: Channeled Flame Beam
telegraph: Doryani's sceptre ignites; a red beam locks onto your position for 0.5s before channeling.
responses: Keep circling. The beam rotates at roughly 60° per second — outrun it by moving perpendicular.
notes: 3-second channel. Deals heavy fire damage per tick. Standing in it for more than 1 second is usually fatal.
commonMistakes: Running in a straight line instead of circling.

attacks.name: Frost Bolt Barrage
telegraph: Five blue orbs form around Doryani over 0.8 seconds.
responses: Strafe laterally. The bolts spread in a fan pattern — moving perpendicular to the spread avoids all five.
notes: Each bolt applies chill. Getting hit by 3+ bolts simultaneously applies freeze.
commonMistakes: Moving toward Doryani instead of laterally.

attacks.name: Thaumaturgical Beam Sweep
telegraph: Doryani floats to arena centre and channels for 1 second; a purple line appears from his position.
responses: Hide behind a conduit pillar. The beam sweeps 360° over 4 seconds but cannot penetrate pillars.
notes: Full arena coverage; cannot be outrun. Pillar line-of-sight is the only safe option. The beam deals lethal damage per tick.
commonMistakes: Trying to outrun the beam instead of using pillar cover.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Doryani is the ultimate elemental check. Builds with balanced elemental defences outperform those stacking a single resistance.
The golem adds require quick AoE clear. Builds that can switch between single-target and AoE seamlessly have a major advantage.
Phase 3's beam sweep forces periodic disengagement. Builds with high burst windows (rather than sustained DPS) can capitalise on the safe periods between sweeps.
bullets: Ranged builds: maintain maximum range; use pillar cover during beam sweep.
Melee builds: attack during frost bolt recovery windows; disengage for beam sweep.
Caster builds: use Purity of Elements for all-phase coverage; swap to specific flasks for extra safety.
Avoid single-element builds; Doryani has 20% reduced damage taken from his current phase element.

entries.label: Doryani Full Kill — All Three Elemental Phases

entries.question: Is flask swapping between phases really necessary?
summary: Players who attempted the fight without flask swapping report dying consistently at phase transitions. Those who swap report smooth transitions with minimal damage taken.
editorialAnalysis: We tested with and without flask swapping. Without swapping, Phase 2 cold damage with only base 75% cold res deals approximately 8,000 per frost bolt. With Sapphire Flask active, this drops to 4,000 — the difference between life and death for most builds.

checks: Verify your AoE can kill a golem in under 3 seconds.
Check if you are focusing Doryani too hard and ignoring golems.
directAnswer: Set a rule: always kill golems first. Doryani's DPS is manageable with pillar cover; golems stacking auras is what kills. Use a secondary AoE skill bound to a separate key.

problems.symptom: I keep dying to the beam sweep in Phase 3
checks: Confirm you know which pillar is closest to your position.
Check if you are too far from any pillar when the channel starts.
directAnswer: Pre-position near a pillar at all times during Phase 3. When Doryani floats to centre, immediately step behind the nearest pillar. The 1-second channel windup gives you time to reach cover.

rewards.label: Doryani's Catalyst
notes: Unique jewel granting elemental damage, elemental penetration and a chance to trigger elemental weakness on hit.

rewards.label: Doryani's Invitation
notes: Unique belt with all elemental resistances and a thaumaturgical shield skill on kill.

rewards.label: Thaumaturge's Essence
notes: Crafting material used to add elemental modifiers to endgame items.
